name: browser-bridge
description: Let AI agents operate a real browser reliably: an MCP server plus an optional Chrome extension, with verified actions and human confirmation for risky steps.
author: Adam Cagle

pnpm.//onlyBuiltDependencies: SUP-01: allowlist for dependency install scripts. Every OTHER transitive dep is blocked from running preinstall/install/postinstall. esbuild is the only dep that legitimately needs its script (it fetches its platform binary; used by the extension bundle and vitest/vite). Playwright 1.62 has NO install script — browsers come from the explicit `playwright install chromium`. A new transitive dep that adds a script fails CLOSED (blocked) until it is reviewed and added here.
